payload.entry: Phase note: (1) Fixed finishRelationLabelRename refused branch to set refusalCode/refusalMessage on failedRename (was on prompt, which has no such members); mergeArmed stays false so next Return arms merge per merge-confirm design. (2) Made CaptureRelationLabelPromptState draftSnapshot/labelRange/restoreCursor var (were let) so completeRelationLabelRename can rebase the card onto the fixed-up draft; doc comments updated. (3) Fixed testRelationCardFiltersAndRanksCatalogLocally second query IM  PLE ->   IMPLE  (old query folds to im ple with a space, correctly matches nothing under bob rank rule in src/native/relation_labels/mod.rs + collapse_label_text); keeps 3-row expectation and selectedKey/authoredLabel asserts. (4) Fixed both Shift+Return timeouts to wait on catalogLoaded==true instead of suggestions non-empty (catalog arrives via empty-label probe; suggestions only carry the typed-row reply since bj.1); kept rest byte-for-byte; confirmed picker-row path rewrites draft before opening card so guard passes and blank fixtures return catalog. (5) Scanned Tests/: no other suggestions.isEmpty waits remain; Tab-cycle tests use synchronous preview helpers, unchanged. bj.9 review: router/controller/view/field/BobProcessClient/models/DependencyDecodingTests/fake-bob compile-clean by inspection (consumeKey, previewLines/footerItems, selectAll, @testable envelope all resolve); fixtures relations-rename-dry-run.json + relation-label-parse-fixup.json decode. Mac offline (ssh mac timeout twice), so BobMacCapture typecheck-tests + XCTest runs UNVERIFIED; macOS CI (phase 12.3) is the compile gate. payload.entry: LAND AUDIT: Read the repair plan, every child scope and note (bj.12.1-.3; no PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries), parent plan and all bj.1-.11 notes. Inspected bob-cli d8a8f1f8 cache source/tests and Mac a2e230e + 569cb36 diffs. CI https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/40146325983 on 569cb364b021cd3e5ae611baed1be9aebb0cbb20 passes Lint, Build and XCTest compilation; required suites pass 47/47 relation panel, 33/33 separator toggle, 13/13 presentation, 29/29 dependency decoding. Exactly 2 of 3087 tests fail: existing non-epic bob-cli-bv (RefsPanelModelTests:2312) and bob-cli-bw (inbox route argv:32); both corroborated with +1. Bundle/signature/smoke/install skipped due to those failures. No unrelated commits since repair creation in the three repositories; audited tips bob-cli d8a8f1f8, Mac 569cb36, plugins 21e9923. Parent-period inbox routes still use common commit_capture_batch, cache invalidation and after-success hides; theme cache, Highlights and Day strip changes do not require further repair integration. Shared vectors match byte-for-byte; 55 focused plugin relation tests pass. No epic-symbols for bj.12 or bj, and no symvision recipe in bob-cli. Remaining EPIC-CAUSED defect: scan.rs removes ANY aged .tmp and every noncurrent version. Exact workspace binary reproduced deletion of unrelated.tmp and future catalog-v999-<64 hex>.json in isolated scratch cache. Plan requires only obsolete catalog versions and owned atomic temps; finish a small tale to narrow matching and add preservation regressions before closing. Inherited DECISIONS honored; no memory edits.

FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE before tale proposal: bj.12.1-.3 contain no PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries. Re-read all parent bj.1-.11 notes and parent land note 3; used sase_new_task, searched all task statuses, swept the past week, and inspected active epics. Outcomes: (1) bj.1#1, bj.3#2, bj.5#1, bj.6#1, bj.7#1, bj.8#1, bj.9#1, bj.10#1, bj.11#1 Task Relation sentence and bj.2#1 Relation label glossary entry remain consolidated in ready memory task bob-cli-bu; no duplicate and no memory edit. (2) bj.8#2 stage-ranker 16ms report remains bob-cli-3w with prior land corroboration; no fresh timing failure observed in this audit and no duplicate +1. (3) bj.3#3 rename snapshot invalidation proposal declined as completed by rename.rs:375 and :842. (4) bj.4#2, bj.5#2/#3, bj.6#2 old clean-base gate failures declined as resolved: theme/completion/help fixes landed in 09b26957 and current just check on d8a8f1f8 passed all 5641 tests (18 result records), fmt and clippy. (5) Revisited prior feature ineligibility: current task(feature) catalog explicitly says agents=yes. bj.4#1 reference-rename transaction reuse is now ready large feature bob-cli-bx, with related links to bob-cli-az and bob-cli-b8; it needs planning to preserve PDF moves, scan locks, rollback and identity behavior. bj.1#2 reliable macOS precommit verification is now ready large feature bob-cli-by, scoped to the missing AppKit/XCTest coverage rather than the already-solved Linux formatter availability. Neither is required for this cache repair. (6) Parent hidden-before-count notes 1/2 are fixed in 556bb67 and now verified by actual XCTest compilation. (7) Current CI failures remain existing ready bob-cli-bv and bob-cli-bw, each +1 corroborated from run 40146325983; no new tasks. Current repair defect (overbroad cache sweep) stays epic work in the proposed small tale. Carry these outcomes into the eventual close note.

CLOSEOUT (relation-cache-pruning tale): Constrained the over-broad catalog sweep in src/native/relation_labels/scan.rs. sweep_catalog_cache now only acts on the generated basename catalog-v<version>-<64 hex>.json and on owned atomic-write temps .catalog-v<version>-<64 hex>.json.<pid>.tmp (numeric PID); all other names, including unrelated.tmp, are left alone. sweep_catalog_file deletes only versions older than CACHE_VERSION (hash-validated); future versions are preserved; current-version keeps the existing vanished-vault/keep-vault/malformed rules. Age check (10 min) applies only to eligible owned temps.

Regression: extended catalog_scan_prunes_vanished_vaults_and_sweeps_orphan_files to keep proving vanished-vault, stale-version, and stale current/older temp deletion, and to preserve an aged unrelated.tmp, a future-version catalog, an aged future-version atomic temp, malformed catalog names (short hash, non-numeric version), and malformed temps (non-numeric PID, short hash), plus the existing live-cache, unparseable, unrelated-text, and fresh-temp keeps. Real Catalog::load in scratch cache; XDG isolated; no new public API; no doc change (existing pruning sentence already describes intended behavior).

Verification: just check passes (fmt, clippy, 5641 tests across 18 result records incl. empty doctests, 0 failures).
